name: Ulta Beauty Rewards Credit Card

apr.notes: Variable APR as of the January 2026 print date of the filed agreement. Late fee up to $41. Minimum interest charge $3.

fx_fee.notes: Store card usable only at Ulta Beauty.

base_rate.description: Store card that may only be used at Ulta Beauty.

rewards.redemption_notes: Points you can redeem for savings through Ulta Beauty Rewards.

benefits.title: 20% off your first purchase
benefits.description: 20% off your first qualifying purchase at Ulta Beauty when you open and use your card.

notes: Private-label store card issued by Comenity Capital Bank (Bread Financial). The 2 points per $1 includes the 1 point every Ulta Beauty Rewards member earns plus 1 additional point for using the card; Platinum and Diamond members earn more.
